newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Bucharest bourse turnover plunges after record.
newsitem.headline: Bucharest bourse turnover plunges after record.

text.p: With heavyweight Azomures SA out of the market, turnover on the Bucharest stock exchange dived to 112.3 million lei on Thursday from an all-time record of 6.3 billion previously.

Azomures fertiliser maker, which took 98 percent of turnover at the previous session, was suspended on after a split of its shares to 1,000 lei from 25,000 following oversubscription in a mass sell-off.
Traders were satisfied with Thursday's turnover level.
"The market trend has improved from last year. In the last few months of 1996 turnover was not as high as today even with Azomures in trading," one said.

Traders expected the market to gain in volume in the sessions ahead. "More stocks are expected to join next week and Azomures will be back to the market, so I think we'll soon see a fresh turnover record," another trader said.
Most prices drifted higher on Thursday in low supply, driving two independent indices to year highs.

Buying interest focused on a handful of stocks, including Carbid-Fox SA, the country's sole producer of carbide, and engineering company Artrom SA, which took the bulk of trading and closed the day stronger.
Carbid traded almost half the total 52,114 shares which changed hands and had 36.1 million lei in turnover. It closed 120 lei higher at 1,590.
Artrom had 27.1 million lei in turnover and a closing price of 3,750 lei, 300 higher on the previous session.
Two unofficial indices -- the VAB and the BIG -- touched year highs, rising 2.1 and respectively 2.21 percent from the previous session.
